composio_alias_incident_2026-07-27.summary: Both Composio Instagram aliases (instagram_cardin-bulgar, labeled 'revitalize_thrive_now_business', and instagram_medlar-slap, labeled 'reclaim_and_rise_now') were OAuth-connected to the same underlying Instagram account (ig_user_id 27634679816148097, username reclaim.and.rise.now). There was no connection at all to Revitalize's real account (ig_user_id 27164026169935796, username revitalize_thrive_now). This caused 15+ consecutive Revitalize posting failures starting 2026-07-22.
composio_alias_incident_2026-07-27.fix: A new Composio Instagram connection was authorized for the real Revitalize account: alias 'revitalize_thrive_now_real', Composio account_id 'instagram_walrus-waac', ig_user_id 27164026169935796 (verified). The old broken connection (instagram_cardin-bulgar) was renamed to 'DEPRECATED_do_not_use_wrong_account' to prevent accidental reuse — it still resolves to the Reclaim account and must never be used for Revitalize again.
composio_alias_incident_2026-07-27.warning_account_type: Both Instagram connections currently report account_type: PRIVATE. Instagram Graph API posting tools (INSTAGRAM_POST_IG_USER_MEDIA) require a Business or Creator account linked to a Facebook Page. If revitalize_thrive_now is still a Personal/Private account, posts may keep failing even with the corrected alias — verify account type in Instagram settings.

composio_alias_incident_2026-07-27.why_not_auto_fixed: These 4 triggers were created via 'http_api' rather than by an agent session (via create_trigger), so both update_trigger and delete_trigger are blocked for this session with: 'Agents can only update/delete routines they created.' This is a hard platform permission boundary. Fix requires either: (a) the account owner editing/recreating these 4 triggers directly (e.g. via the Claude Code web/app UI or the API that originally created them), replacing every 'instagram_cardin-bulgar' reference with 'revitalize_thrive_now_real', or (b) asking a Claude Code session to run create_trigger for 4 new replacement triggers with the corrected prompt and then manually deleting the old 4 via the UI.
